This gives you the highest-potential monopoly on the board and plenty of liquidity to unmortgage your holdings.

payload.thought: I'm offering Grok a path to the Dark Blue monopoly and 2/3 of the Yellows in exchange for New York Avenue. With New York, I complete the Orange monopoly, the most landed-on set in the game. I plan to immediately use the remaining bank houses to develop the Oranges, which will sustain the house shortage and prevent Grok from building up his new acquisitions. Even if he refuses, I'm essentially daring him to make a move while I hold a strong defensive position with my Pinks and Railroads.
